findings.claim: The 'Delta de sequência V3' section still names four obligatory future gate paths as ctg-0001-c4-od-v3-sql-review-1.{manifest.json,json,bridge.json}, but the real SQL review1 artifacts landed under the different name ctg-0001-c4-od-v3-review-sql-1.* with verdict REVIEW. The corrective section historicizes 'os paths SQL review1 anteriores' and requires 'manifesto/veredito SQL review2 exatos' for completion, yet never reconciles the misnamed sql-review-1 paths nor enumerates the exact SQL review2 artifact paths. The gate remains fail-closed (absence blocks), but a literal worker could stay BLOCKED forever on names that will never exist, or ambiguity could arise over which future manifest satisfies the completion gate.
findings.fix: Before dispatching TASK-0030, add one superseding sentence to the corrective section (new composition SHA registered in compositions.json and tasks/TASK-0030.json, old entry retained as history) stating that the delta-section sql-review-1 paths are satisfied historically by the existing review-sql-1.* REVIEW artifacts, and enumerate the exact SQL review2 completion-gate paths (e.g. work/rounds/R-0007/reviews/attempt-2/ctg-0001-c4-od-v3-review-sql-2.json plus its .manifest.json and .bridge.json) alongside work/rounds/R-0007/reports/TASK-0028-V3-DB.md.

findings.claim: The governed acceptance_commands in TASK-0034.json (and identically TASK-0035.json line 30) omit the DETRAN_TEST_TIER=unit environment variable that both prompts mandate. Today this is benign only because backend/domains/inf/rait-case/vitest.config.ts line 3 defaults the tier to 'unit', so the recorded argv still collects tests/unit/**; but if that default ever changes, the recorded gate silently diverges from prompt intent and could collect zero files, with only the --passWithNoTests=false flag left to catch it.
findings.fix: Encode the tier explicitly in the governed record, e.g. use ['pnpm','--filter','@detran/inf-rait-case','test:unit','--passWithNoTests=false','tests/unit/rait-case-command-contract.spec.ts'] (the test:unit script already sets DETRAN_TEST_TIER=unit) in both TASK-0034.json and TASK-0035.json, so record and prompt express the same command.

notes: Item 1 — sequence traced acyclic: independent corrective prompt-review PASS gates everything; then TASK-0028 supplemental static sensor within the same 1/1 checkpoint (no counter reset, zero DB), TASK-0034 Inspector RED, TASK-0035 Engineer GREEN on the frozen sensor SHA, TASK-0030 single 0/1→1/1 iteration for preparatory three-output generation only, held in_progress; SQL review2 PASS on the actual generated bytes, audited fixture recipe, then full TASK-0028 DB PASS on the same hashes precede TASK-0030 completion. No gate consumes its own later output. Counters verified in the governed records: TASK-0028 checkpoint 1/1, TASK-0029 checkpoint 1/1, TASK-0030/0034/0035 queued 0/1, TASK-0020 and TASK-0021 preserved at 3/4 (tasks/TASK-0002-D1.json, tasks/TASK-0003-D1.json), TASK-0023 completed 2/2.

Item 2 — all 35 read-set paths exist on disk, including docs/meta/agents/inspector-tests.md, engineer-backend.md and architect-blueprint.md (TASK-0035 additionally carries a STOP-if-manual-name-differs clause). Allowlists resolve to real single files; locks are disjoint (MOD-rait-case-tests for the unit spec vs MOD-rait-case for the service vs MOD-rait-priority-upgrade-tests for the integration spec), single-writer and no shared R-0010 lock are explicit, and the Maestro only registers evidence. TASK-0034/0035 are valid new schemaVersion 2.0.0 records; PC-13d8859075656b3c, PC-8942785ef00798dd, PC-ebdce939d6a04537 and PC-e54998a099dd840f all match compositions.json SHA entries, and the older TASK-0028/0030 composition rows remain as history. ctg-0001-c4-od-v3-review-sql-1.json (verdict REVIEW) and its per-file SHA-256 manifest exist and are declared immutable at every stage.

Item 3 — feasibility confirmed in the actual bytes: tests/unit/rait-case-command-contract.spec.ts already exercises claim-next through caseRuntime and inspects runtime.queries, so the sensor can capture the real claim-next SQL; the current service orders by 'item.legal_priority desc nulls last, item.protocolled_at, item.id' (rait-case-command.service.ts:1533-1534), so a CASE-rank assertion produces a genuine contractual RED, and the correction is confinable to that one ORDER BY while filters, tenant predicate, impediment/assignment exclusions, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and the protocolled_at/id tie-breakers stay untouched. --passWithNoTests=false correctly overrides passWithNoTests:true in vitest.config.ts, and both prompts demand positive collection counts. Sensor and Engineer edit disjoint files with the sensor SHA frozen between them.

Item 4 — the TASK-0028 corrective section mandates exactly the SQL1-F2 exposure: four positive modes (none, age_60_plus, age_80_plus, pcd with document/attachment/hash) each as INSERT plus qualification plus successful COMMIT in one transaction under role_app_backend with app.tenant_id, proving projection, revision=1 and append-only assessment/basis rows, plus spoofed pg_temp marker and post-protocol requalification negatives with no persisted effect, preserving prior scenarios and the legacy baseline. Authorship is static-only (collection/typecheck/Prettier, zero DB) and is never called DB PASS; SQL review2 explicitly reviews the newly frozen sensor bytes. Root scripts parameters:generate, parameters:test and verify:parameter-catalogue exist in package.json.

Item 5 — TASK-0030 corrects only the three on-disk derivatives via the official generator (ADR-0024 JSON object, byte-identical second generation, STOP on extra output), never existing DB rows; seed keeps ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and no seed/DB apply is permitted. A pre-reviewed explicit fixture recipe audited in SQL2 is obligatory before any DB mutation, and its absence is STOP/reference-gap. The Clock low stays with TASK-0021 with no build/runtime PASS claims, and the DDL05/14 catalogue low keeps the eleven-row fail-closed preflight without loosening.
